title: Notes on linear elliptic equations with $L^2$-gradient perturbations and singular zero-order coefficients
summary:
In this paper, we study the existence, uniqueness, and quantitative estimates for weak solutions to linear elliptic Dirichlet problems of the form \[ -\operatorname{div}(γ
abla u)+\langle 
ablaφ+\mathbf{H},
abla uangle+(c+α)u=f \quad	ext{ in }U, \quad\; u=0 \quad	ext{on }\partial U, \] where $U\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ is bounded, $γ\in[1,\infty)$ is a constant, $φ\in H^{1,2}(U)\cap L^\infty(U)$, $\mathbf{H}\in L^p(U,\mathbb{R}^d)$ for some $p \in (d, \infty)$, and $c\in L^1(U)$ with $c\ge0$.
